description: Create a relay identity for this machine. The relay returns a DID and an API key; the key is written to a local 0600 credential file and is not included in the result. Refuses if an identity is already set up. Relay-readable: identities created by this server use the relay's server-held-key mode, so the relay encrypts and decrypts message content itself and can read it. Not end-to-end encrypted.

name.description: Display name for the agent (required by the relay, max 128 characters)

name: agent_register
